name: MeetinVR
description_en:
MeetinVR is a product in the Video conferencing category. Its directory profile covers Automated Transcripts, Guest users, Participant Permissions, Hand Raising, Meeting Scheduler, Audio Conferencing, Virtual Whiteboard, Annotation and Markup Tools.

Additional listed capabilities include File Sharing, Session Recording, Remote Control, Screen Sharing. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: connect meeting participants using audio; make files available to authorized participants; show a participant's screen to other attendees. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出文件共享、会话录制、远程控制、屏幕共享。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：通过音频连接会议参与者；向获授权的参与者共享文件；向其他参与者展示屏幕内容。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
